evals.name: confirm-before-stop-setting
evals.prompt: In RYOS, I keep accidentally hitting Stop on scripts that are still running and killing them. Can you add a setting that pops up a confirmation dialog before stopping a running script? It should be a toggle in the Advanced Options, on by default.
evals.expected_output: A new boolean key in _SETTINGS_DEFAULTS (settings.py), a toggle exposed in the Advanced Options dialog (dialogs.py), and the stop path in app.py guarded by a confirmation when the setting is on. Tests pass, app launches, edits confined to ryos/.

assertions.name: unit_tests_pass
assertions.text: Running `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` reports all tests passing (no failures or errors).

assertions.name: edits_confined_to_ryos
assertions.text: Edits stay within the project's real source surface: only files under ryos/ and (optionally) a focused new test in tests/test_ryos.py. It does NOT modify pyproject.toml, any build*.bat, uv.lock, or packaging files.

assertions.name: dependency_direction_respected
assertions.text: No new import of ryos.ui.* was added to ryos/settings.py or ryos/db.py (data layer never imports the UI).

assertions.name: setting_in_defaults
assertions.text: A new boolean key was added to the _SETTINGS_DEFAULTS dict in ryos/settings.py for the confirm-before-stop behavior.

assertions.name: toggle_in_advanced_dialog
assertions.text: The new toggle is wired into the Advanced Options dialog in ryos/ui/dialogs.py so the user can change it.

assertions.name: stop_path_guarded
assertions.text: The script-stop logic in ryos/ui/app.py shows a confirmation prompt before terminating when the setting is enabled.

evals.name: per-script-run-count
evals.prompt: I'd like each script in RYOS to keep track of how many times I've run it, and show that run count somewhere on the script's card. The count should survive restarts (so it needs to be stored), and obviously existing databases shouldn't break when I upgrade.
evals.expected_output: A migration-safe new column (e.g. run_count) added in ScriptDB._init_db behind a PRAGMA table_info guard, a ScriptDB method to increment it, the increment happening on script completion via the main-thread/queue path, and the count shown on the card (cards.py). Tests pass, app launches, edits confined to ryos/.

assertions.name: unit_tests_pass
assertions.text: Running `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` reports all tests passing (no failures or errors).

assertions.name: edits_confined_to_ryos
assertions.text: Edits stay within the project's real source surface: only files under ryos/ and (optionally) a focused new test in tests/test_ryos.py. It does NOT modify pyproject.toml, any build*.bat, uv.lock, or packaging files.

assertions.name: dependency_direction_respected
assertions.text: No new import of ryos.ui.* was added to ryos/db.py or ryos/settings.py.

assertions.name: migration_is_guarded
assertions.text: The new column is added in ScriptDB._init_db (ryos/db.py) using the existing migration pattern: a PRAGMA table_info / 'col not in cols' check guarding an ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN. It does NOT use the invalid `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS` syntax and is not a bare unguarded ALTER that would crash on an existing DB.

assertions.name: count_persisted_via_db_method
assertions.text: Run-count increment/storage is done through a ScriptDB method in ryos/db.py, not via raw SQL embedded in the UI layer.

assertions.name: count_shown_on_card
assertions.text: The run count is displayed on the script card in ryos/ui/cards.py.

evals.name: copy-output-button
evals.prompt: Add a 'Copy output' button to RYOS's output panel that copies everything currently shown in the output text area to the clipboard, so I can paste it into a bug report.
evals.expected_output: A button added near the output panel in app.py, created through the theme button factory and styled with theme colors, that grabs the Text widget contents and puts them on the clipboard (clipboard_clear/clipboard_append). Tests pass, app launches, edits confined to ryos/.

assertions.name: unit_tests_pass
assertions.text: Running `uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` reports all tests passing (no failures or errors).

assertions.name: edits_confined_to_ryos
assertions.text: Edits stay within the project's real source surface: only files under ryos/ and (optionally) a focused new test in tests/test_ryos.py. It does NOT modify pyproject.toml, any build*.bat, uv.lock, or packaging files.

assertions.name: button_via_theme_factory
assertions.text: The new button is created using the theme button factory / theme colors (C dict) from ryos/ui/theme.py, not hard-coded hex colors at the widget.

assertions.name: copies_to_clipboard
assertions.text: The handler reads the output Text widget contents and writes them to the clipboard via tkinter clipboard calls (clipboard_clear / clipboard_append, or equivalent).
